english.title: Tout for / solicit money / employment on a tram / a tramstop / at the Information Centre on the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) touted for or solicited

(A)_[money]_
(B)_[reward]_
(C)_[custom]_
(D)_[employment]_

(E)_[on a tram, namely **(..SPECIFY TRAM..),]_
(F)_[on a tramstop, namely **(..SPECIFY TRAMSTOP..),]_
(G)_[at the Tramlink Information Centre]_

without the written permission of the Operator
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 8(3)(b) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
